description_en: Creates an AgenticDB tenant API key
description_zh: 创建 AgenticDB 租户 API Key
kebab_example: aliyun polardb create-agentic-db-tenant-api-key --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id pagc-bp1abcdef1234567 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAgenticDBTenantApiKey

parameters.help_en: The AgenticDB cluster ID, which starts with pagc-. You must first call CreateDBCluster and set AgenticDbType to dedicated and ServerlessType to AgileServerless to create an AgenticDB cluster, and then pass the returned DBClusterId
parameters.help_zh: AgenticDB 集群 ID，以 pagc- 开头。需先调用 CreateDBCluster，并指定 AgenticDbType=dedicated、ServerlessType=AgileServerless 创建 AgenticDB 集群，再传入其返回的 DBClusterId
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the existing tenant
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The tenant name. It must be unique within the cluster and be 2 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 租户名称，同集群下唯一，2-64 字符
parameters.name: tenant_name

parameters.help_en: The expiration time in ISO 8601 format. If this parameter is not specified, the API key never expires
parameters.help_zh: 过期时间（ISO 8601），不传则永不过期
parameters.name: expire_time

ApiKey.description_en: The plaintext of the API key. This value is returned only in the current response
ApiKey.description_zh: API Key 明文，仅本次返回
ApiKey.title_en: API Key 明文，仅本次返回
ApiKey.title_zh: API Key 明文，仅本次返回

ApiKeyId.description_en: The resource ID of the API key

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard and is displayed in UTC (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ)
CreateTime.description_zh:
创建时间

时间采用 ISO 8601 格式，时区为 UTC（格式：YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ）

ExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time. If the API key never expires, this value is empty. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard and is displayed in UTC (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ)
ExpireTime.description_zh:
过期时间，永不过期时为空

时间采用 ISO 8601 格式，时区为 UTC（格式：YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ）
ExpireTime.title_en: 过期时间，永不过期时为空
ExpireTime.title_zh: 过期时间，永不过期时为空
